verdict.rationale: Carta documents an OAuth-authorized API with endpoints for the capitalization table by share class, stakeholders, option grants, and convertible notes, plus a guide to computing outstanding and fully diluted percentages from the cap table endpoint. This covers the core of programmatic cap-table access. Missing for 10: any explicit evidence of vesting-state data, endpoints that are still versioned v1alpha1, no published OpenAPI spec found, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
